original_test_intent: Benchmark all approved 3.84TB E1.S devices through the four named sequential/random read/write workloads and compare capacity/SKU-specific per-drive behavior with customer requirements, without exposing protected data.
original_method: Pending a safe specification: bind serial/WWN/model/firmware/namespace/BDF/slot to disposable 3.84TB targets; exclude boot/data and prove backup; approve raw-versus-file mode, dataset/offset, runtime, preconditioning, steady-state, repeats and order; capture per-profile IOPS/BW/latency percentiles; enforce model endurance, temperature, power, SMART/media-error stops; verify integrity/cleanup/post-health.
manual_activity: Storage owner approves each 3.84TB disposable drive, workload/endurance and model-specific SPEC, backup and recovery.
safety_requirements: Stop on degradation; no retry/log clear

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Safe version discovery only; cannot be counted as benchmark execution.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Do not generate commands until serial-bound targets and capacity-specific profiles are approved; preserve each source job option in the final explicit jobs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: 2MiB seq R/W, 4KiB random R/W, direct/libaio, depth16/jobs16 and all 3.84TB E1.S coverage retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Benchmark serial-bound disposable devices one at a time after common preconditioning, collecting repeated JSON outputs and capacity/SKU health deltas.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable capacity-specific identity, workload reproducibility, numeric oracle and post-write safety.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The similar 1.92TB row cannot substitute because firmware, overprovisioning, endurance and SPEC may differ by capacity.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: High-concurrency writes can rapidly consume endurance/thermal headroom; unresolved runtime makes exposure unbounded.

project_override_considerations: Owner states whether 3.84TB has its own SPEC, allowed cross-capacity comparison, raw namespace versus file target, steady-state method and sampling/statistic.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek safely limits itself to discovery and does not contradict the source; missing execution details remain explicit.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Writable targets, runtime and customer SPEC are unresolved, making source execution both destructive and unverifiable.

review_improvement: Keeps the 3.84TB SKU as independent coverage and blocks unsafe inference from the adjacent 1.92TB benchmark.
independent_technical_reasoning: Equal fio arguments do not imply equal acceptance across capacities: controller firmware, NAND geometry, overprovisioning and endurance can change both steady-state output and safe write exposure. The 3.84TB target set and oracle must be independently approved.
